worlds.title: Revision River Ferry
worlds.premise: A paper ferry carries young editors between draft islands, where every stop reveals a stronger way to shape a story.
prompts: Opening prompt: Your hero boards the Revision River Ferry with a messy first draft, three colored pencils, and a map that only shows the beginning.
Twist prompt: The ferry will not cross the comma-current until the hero moves one scene, cuts one extra detail, and adds one clue that matters later.
Ending-choice prompt: Choose the final dock: a polished chapter reading, a peer editor exchange, or a quiet author note explaining the best revision.
heroChoices: A structure scout who spots missing bridges between scenes
A detail sorter who decides what stays, moves, or leaves
A ferry apprentice who turns feedback into calm next steps
settingDetails: Draft islands labeled Opening, Middle, Turn, and Finish
Floating sticky-note buoys that mark confusing paragraphs
A ferry bell that rings only when a revision makes the story clearer
worlds.conflict: The ferry route is out of order, so the hero must rebuild the story sequence without blaming any writer for the messy draft.
